description: This file defines a RecyclerView.Adapter implementation called BannerAdapter, which manages a horizontal carousel of banner images. It inflates item views, binds image URLs using Coil library, and provides a method to update the images dynamically.

classes.name: BannerAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for binding banner image URLs into a RecyclerView for horizontal scrolling.

classes.name: BannerViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class for individual banner item views.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the banner item layout and creates a ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Loads the banner image URL into the ImageView with placeholders and crossfade.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of banner items.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Updates the list of banner URLs and refreshes the RecyclerView.
